# ChangeiP


> ChangeiP is a domain, DNS, hosting, and SSL provider for solopreneurs, small businesses, and DIY network admins. It offers free and paid Dynamic DNS (DDNS), domain registration/transfer (200+ TLDs), DNS hosting, VPS and shared web hosting, and SSL certificates. Serving over 1 million clients over 20+ years, with 24/7 support and a 7-day money-back guarantee.


## Products & Services


- [Dynamic DNS](https://changeip.com/dns/): Free and paid DDNS services that automatically keep a domain name pointed at a changing IP address, useful for home servers, remote access, and small businesses without a static IP. Includes Free DDNS with a pre-selected domain, DDNS Premium for existing domains, and Paid DNS Hosting with unlimited URL redirection.
- [Domains](https://changeip.com/domains/): Domain registration starting at $15 and transfers starting at $12, with over 200 TLDs available (.com, .org, .net, .ai, .tv, .cloud, .site, .app, and more). Registrations include free DNS hosting and a 30-day trial of Premium DDNS.
- [SSL Certificates](https://changeip.com/ssl/): GeoTrust SSL certificates ranging from RapidSSL (single domain, email validation) to Wildcard, QuickSSL Premium, and True BusinessID EV (extended validation), with up to $1.75M in warranty coverage and up to 256-bit encryption.
- [Hosting](https://changeip.com/hosting/): Web hosting (shared cPanel hosting) and VPS (Virtual Private Server) hosting for scaling businesses, with SSD-powered infrastructure and data centers in Los Angeles, Ashburn VA, Chicago, Amsterdam, and Singapore.
  - [Web Hosting](https://changeip.com/hosting/web/)
  - [VPS Hosting](https://changeip.com/hosting/vps/)


## Company


- [About](https://changeip.com/about/): Background on ChangeiP as a company.
- [Partners](https://changeip.com/partners/): Partner program information.
- [Blog](https://changeip.com/blog/): Articles on DNS, hosting, and related topics.
- [Privacy Policy](https://changeip.com/privacy/)
- [Terms of Service](https://changeip.com/terms/)
- [Service Agreement](https://changeip.com/service-agreement/)


## Resources & Support


- [Resources](https://changeip.com/resources/): Help articles and guides.
- [Knowledgebase](https://www.changeip.com/accounts/knowledgebase.php): Support articles for existing customers.
- [Client Login](https://www.changeip.com/accounts/clientarea.php): Account management portal.


## Notes


- ChangeiP is not a Fortune 500 brand; it targets individual site owners, small businesses, and network admins needing simple, affordable DNS/hosting/domain tools.
- Pricing mentioned on the site is subject to change; refer to live product pages for current rates.

ESTABLISH A RELIABLE ONLINE PRESENCE AND ENSURE YOUR AUDIENCE CAN ALWAYS FIND YOU.

You deserve an easy, economical, reliable solution to reinforce your business. And you don’t have to do it alone.

Forget trying to DIY your web hosting.

Efficiently establish your online presence, secure your business, and shore up your domain with services from ChangeiP.

Dynamic DNS

Daily IP maintenance? No, thanks. Stop the headaches and leave the DNS admin to us.

Keep all your systems connected without having to manually make one-off IP changes.

We offer a variety of options to fit your needs and budget, even if that budget is $0. Utilize our Free DDNS service to automatically update records, or upgrade to Paid DDNS services and build out your existing operations.

Level up your business and migrate to cost-effective, easy-to-use shared hosting. When it’s time for big growth, upgrade to a virtual private server that will scale with you.

No fluff. No unnecessary bells and whistles.

We’re here to get you up and running with hyper-specific tools built to help you establish your online presence.

THAT’S WHY WE’VE DEDICATED 20 YEARS TO DELIVERING SERVICES THAT TAKE THE HEAVY LIFTING OFF YOUR PLATE SO YOU CAN FOCUS ON EXACTLY WHAT YOU NEED TO RUN YOUR BUSINESS.

Join More than 1M Satisfied Clients

Additional Goodies

Easy Setup

Easily connect other ChangeIP products or 3rd party services, social media within minutes.

Add subdomains to your domain. Have a store? Not a problem. Easily direct traffic to store.yourawesomedomain.com.

Security
